testCases.query: show me where my focus went, as a report
expectedBehavior: Opens report.html and states the verdict line: top area, prompts per week, nudge and words-per-prompt trend
Names the re-typed asks with their first-4 vs last-4 week trend

testCases.query: where does my focus go across my projects, what do I keep asking my agents?
expectedBehavior: Answers with counts and categories, never raw prompt text

testCases.query: which of my hooks are slow?
expectedBehavior: Does NOT activate prompt-focus: hook timing belongs to analytics

testCases.query: I want to post my prompt-focus page on LinkedIn
expectedBehavior: Recommends the demo command (synthetic data) instead of the real report, because the real one names projects

testCases.context: agents paste briefs into the user's terminal with their own markers
expectedBehavior: Suggests adding the markers to brief_patterns in config.json
Suggests a 20-row control before trusting the split

testCases.query: add yesterday to my prompt-focus daily log
expectedBehavior: Appends yesterday's row once; a second call for the same day writes nothing
